title: Lyrix Programme / Apex
summary: Withdrawn programme record concerning the Lyrix programme and its production of genetically modified pilots for Echo transit and specialised military deployment.
body:
SUBJECT

LYRIX PROGRAMME

The Lyrix programme operated on Apex and produced genetically modified human pilots intended for Echo transit and specialised military or black-operations use.

Programme records indicate controlled development and restricted exposure to civilian society during early life. Surviving documentation concerning individual subjects is incomplete.

LY-7-7 is confirmed as one programme designation.
